description: [Read · free] Resolve an audience segment into a concrete list of person_ids. For manual / auto_stream segments, returns stored members. For smart segments, evaluates the segment's `config` predicate (title_contains / company_contains) and returns matches ordered by engagement with your posts. Smart segments only match people connected to you: people who engaged with posts you can see in Flux (your own profile, tracked/monitored profiles, and posts you collected) and people in your campaigns' constellations. Free — costs 0 credits.
name: resolve_segment
title: Resolve Audience Segment
